text:
Football Italia Live Blog
Join us for all the build-up and action as it happens from today’s four Serie A games, Napoli-Roma, Lazio-Parma, Como-Sassuolo and Cagliari-Bologna.
We begin at 14.00 UK time (15.00 CEST) with two matches, as Como ride the Champions League wave after crushing Manchester United by hosting Sassuolo, and Cagliari try to recover against Bologna.
There’s a massive Scudetto battle at 17.00 UK (18.00 CEST) as Napoli take on Roma with both teams dealing with injuries.
Joint leaders Lazio try to keep their amazing form going against Alberto Gilardino’s Parma at 19.45 UK time (20.45 CEST).
- All
- Favourites 0
Bernardeschi off, Mbangula on for Bologna
Van Der Brempt booked against his former club for taking down Caqueret.
Sebastiano Esposito on for Sassuolo, replacing Adzic.
Vitik on, Darmian off.
Massolin replaced by Aurelio.
Cheeky Bernardeschi dinked free kick, but the wall manages to get something on it.
Cambiaghi brought down right on the very edge of the area. A free kick is given, it’s just outside. Just.
Sassuolo free kick into the box, but they fail to make much of it. They don’t seem to have a lot of belief right now.
Bernardeschi becomes the first Bologna player to score more than once in Serie A this season.
Bernardeschi dribbles away from Deiola and hits a scorcher from the edge of the area, which is charged down by a flailing Juan Rodriguez arm!
Deiola does finally go into the book for a shirt tug, which he had escaped in the first half.
Amondarain, Rahim Alhassane and Libra on for Bologna, Zortea, Odgaard and Miranda off.
Cagliari introduce Fadera for Romano.
Berardi off, Volpato on for Sassuolo, celebrating a new contract.
Chances at both ends, first a Mendy header is plucked out of the air by Skorupski, then Casale gets down the right and pulls back from the by-line, parried with difficulty.
Sassuolo are such a mess that Turati takes too long to take the goal kick and gifts Como a corner.
Odd one with a Como corner, the Sassuolo defender clears it onto the face of Ramon.
Then Sassuolo get into a mess playing out from the back and Milla incredibly prods it wide from 12 yards!
Yan Couto off for Como, Smolcic on
Maldini off, Kevin Carlos on for Cagliari.
Yan Couto booked for a lunge of a sliding tackle.
Berardi effort deflected, then on the Sassuolo corner Caleta-Car can’t keep the looping header on target.
Skorupski rushes off his line and flaps at the Maldini cross to get it away.
Lipani, Lauriente’ and Doig on, Matic, Dominguez and Obrador off for Sassuolo.
He cannot stop scoring at the moment, that’s his second of the game!
All the credit goes to Kaiki, who fights to intercept a wayward play out from the back, rides a challenge nad pulls back from the left, where Douvikas comes sliding in to meet it from 10 yards!
Luis Milla free kick flashes all the way across the face of goal and skims the far post! Went under Adzic’s legs…
Those Bologna corners were piling up and this time Miranda found Casale for a free header from six yards! The Cagliari defenders were nowhere near him…
Jacobo Ramon has a pop from distance and it’s not far over for Como.
digest_he: המחזור בסרייה A מזמן היום שורה של משחקים מרתקים, ובהם המפגש של קומו המגיעה על גל ההצלחה מאירופה מול ססואולו, והמשחק בין קליארי לבולוניה. בהמשך הערב מצפה קרב צמרת מסקרן בין נאפולי לרומא, בעוד המוליכות המשותפות לאציו יפגשו את פארמה. הדיווחים החיים כוללים את אירועי המפתח על המגרש, חילופים, כרטיסים צהובים ומצבים נייחים לאורך ההתמודדויות השונות.
